summary: doctor powder reachability check does not propagate POWDER_API_KEY from the instance environment file. doctorPowderCheck reads POWDER_AGENT and POWDER_URL/POWDER_API_BASE_URL from the service env file but never reads or forwards POWDER_API_KEY to the powder list subprocess. An operator running forest doctor from a shell without that exported variable (the normal case; the value lives in %h/.config/iron-forest/<instance>.env) gets a powder probe with no auth, so a real authenticated Powder server rejects it and doctor reports powder_reachability unhealthy (exit 2) for a correctly configured instance. Required state: doctorPowderCheck must read POWDER_API_KEY from the same env file and pass it in the probe environment without printing it. Evidence: doctor.go lines 233-263 build probeEnv from POWDER_AGENT and POWDER_URL/POWDER_API_BASE_URL only; reproduction with a stub powder that requires POWDER_API_KEY returned powder_reachability evidenced=false with 'powder: missing POWDER_API_KEY' while the env file contained a key.
